desc: Seen from BEHIND (back view, face not shown). The black cape must not cover the body: swing the cape out to the side or let it hang behind the legs, with the red lining and gold trim visible and the cape shading a little brighter so it separates from the black coat. Keep the back, long black hair, sword arm and the steel sword clearly visible in every frame; the sword is never hidden. Keep the same character and size. No flashes or glow.
